svg.title: What a platform owner can do with a school
svg.desc: The owner opens a school and reads its overview, people, support access, notes and health. From School controls the owner can extend the trial, rename the school, archive it after downloading a copy, or help a stuck admin. Operations, Users and Audit are separate pages in the left menu, and every action is written in the audit.
